title: The UAP-era reception posture
statement: The corpus's posture toward the modern UAP complex — disclosure claims, alleged cover-ups, crop formations, and the documented post-1945 secrecy machinery the accountability journalism has actually established — is registration without enlistment: none of it is evidence for the framework, whose anticipated contact is specific, official, and conditional (woh-claim-0015), and whose provenance rests on the reports of woh-claim-0020 rather than on any craft in any sky; documented government secrecy is carried at documentary strength, undocumented cover-up claims at their own contested grade, and the corpus's Dispatch coverage of UAP news operates under this record.

includes: The separation, which is the posture's spine: the canon's contact-specificity (dated reports; an official, conditional return) means UAP phenomena confirm nothing for the framework and their debunking refutes nothing in it
The documentary layer at its own strength: the post-1945 secrecy machinery that FOIA-based journalism has established is historical fact, registered as such
The contested layer at its own grade: cover-up-of-exobiology claims, crop-formation attributions, and disclosure-movement assertions carried as contested claims with their skeptical accounts in full
The Dispatch discipline: UAP news items are read through this record — the event reported, the posture applied, no enlistment either way
excludes: Any UAP event as evidence for the framework, or any debunking as evidence against it
Adjudication of specific incidents; per-incident work is the Dispatch genre's, under this posture
Enlistment of the accountability journalists, who hold their own positions and no metaphysics
The movement's own UFO-culture history, which is organizational

source_references.locator: The official-and-conditional return frame (via woh-claim-0015) that grounds the separation
The scholarship on UFO-religion reception dynamics the posture is built against
The reception scholarship's account of contactee movements and modern phenomena claims

alternatives.statement: A posture on which no UAP evidence can confirm and no debunking can disconfirm insulates the framework from the one evidence stream its subject matter invites; the separation is apologetic architecture.
The movement is historically part of the UFO milieu; the corpus's distance is a later repositioning, not a structural feature.

revision_triggers: Claim woh-claim-0015 or woh-claim-0020 is revised or retired.
An official, verified disclosure event occurs — the one UAP-complex development the separation does not firewall, which would move this record and much else.
Dispatch prose begins enlisting UAP news for the framework or mocking it against the framework, both of which this record excludes.
